title: Energy - 123 school
heading: Energy
intro: Test your knowledge by typing your answer and comparing it with the correct answer. Then click 'Check answers'.
All the data you need is in the question. Round to the correct number of digits.

questions.q: Which type of energy does a moving bicycle have?
In which type of energy is the energy stored in petrol?
Which of these energy sources is a fossil fuel?
Which of these energy sources is renewable (sustainable)?
Which energy conversion takes place in a solar cell?
Which energy conversion takes place in a bicycle dynamo?
Which energy conversion takes place in an electric motor?
Name two renewable energy sources.
questions.a: For example solar energy, wind energy, hydroelectric power, biomass or geothermal energy

questions.q: What does the law of conservation of energy state?
questions.a: Energy is not lost but is converted into another form

questions.q: Which formula goes with heating a substance?

What is the efficiency of an appliance?
questions.a: Useful energy divided by total energy, times 100%

questions.a: The gas between the panes conducts heat poorly
